What is the ruling on the delay of Hajj if someone is capable?
ما حكم تأخير الحج
What are the compensations or rulings for a pilgrim who misses or incorrectly performs the standing at Arafat?
ما حكم ترك الحاج وقوف عرفة؟
What is the ruling on correcting the throwing of the Jamarat if someone misses throwing for a day or two?
كيف يتدارك من نسي رمي الجمرات فب الحج؟
What is the ruling on qada of the Farewell Tawaf?
كيف يتدارك من نسي طواف الوداع
What is the ruling on applying perfume to body and clothing in preparation for and during Ihram?
ما حكم التطيب في الحج للثوب و البدن قبل و بعد الاحرام؟
Can I enter Ihram for both ‘Umrah and Hajj simultaneously when performing Mutamatti' hajj?
ما هو حكم تقديم العمرة على الحج للمتمتع، ومتى يصح التمتع  إذا أُحرم بالعمرة والحج معًا؟

If a woman enters the state of Ihram for Hajj as Mufrada or Qarinah, and then menstruation or postpartum bleeding prevents her from performing Tawaf, what should she do regarding the Hajj rites and Tawaf?
ما حكم المرأة إذا أحرمت بالحج مفردة أو قارنة، ثم منعها الحيض أو النفاس من أداء الطواف؟
What is the ruling on entering into ihram for Umrah after entering into ihram for Hajj ?
ما هو حكم إِضَافَةُ إِحْرَامِ الْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ
What is the ruling on the Farewell Tawaf?
ما هو حكم طَوَافُ الْوَدَاعِ
If a person has a sexual intercourse before exiting ihram is Umrah invalidated? if yes, what is the expiation for it?
ما هي مفسدات العمرة
if someone owes past Zakat but later loses the wealth on which Zakat was due, does the obligation of Zakat remain?
ما حكم من تعسر عليه اخراج الزكاة بعد وجوبها؟
When cattle reach one hundred and twenty, who has the choice in deciding the type of cattle given as zakat between three musinnas or four tabi'as?
ماذا يجب أن يُخرج في زكاة البقر
What is the ruling on taking male camels for zakat when the female camels are lost or defective?
ما هو حكم أخذ الذكور في زكاة الإبل عند فقد الأنثى أو وجودها معيبة؟
What is the ruling on accelerating the payment of Zakat before the lunar year?
ما حكم التَّعْجِيل بِإِخْرَاجِ الزَّكَاةِ قَبْل الْحَوْل
How far into future is it permissible to advance zakat?
ما هي الْمُدَّةِ الَّتِي يَجُوزُ تَعْجِيل الزَّكَاةِ
Does selling the nisab (zakatable amount) of trade goods during the year interrupt the Zakat year?
ما هو حكم تغيير نصاب الزكاة أثناء الحول
When does zakat become obligatory on fruits, such as dates?
متى يجب اخراج الزكاة في الثمار
What is the obligatory amount in the zakat of fruits depending on the irrigation method?
ما هو  الْقَدْرُ الْوَاجِبُ فِي زَكَاةِ الثَّمَرِ
What is the ruling on giving zakat to the grandfather?
ما حُكْمُ دَفْعِ الزَّكَاةِ لِلْجَدِّ
Is mandatory to pay zakat on the wealth of the insane?
ما حكم زكاة من مال المجنون و من يخرجها؟
Does a professional have to pay zakat on his tools of work?
ما حكم الزَّكاة في الات الحرف التجارية
Which types of wealth does a full lunar year need to pass on for the zakat to be obligatory?
هل الحول شرط لوجوب الزكاة؟
For which types of wealth, there is no requirement for a full lunar year to pass on for the zakat to be obligatory?
هل الحول شرط لوجوب زكاة الثمار
What is the ruling if zakat is given to someone thought to be eligible, but it turns out to be a mistake?
ما هو حكم دفع الزكاة لشخص ظنَّ الدافع أنه من أهل الزكاة ثم تبين أنه لم يكن من أهلها؟
Is it allowed to give away all ones wealth in charity such that nothing is left to support oneself and dependants?
ما حكم الإِْسْرَافُ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ
Should the imam command the people to give charity before performing the prayer for rain (istisqā’)?
ما حكم الصَّدَقَةُ قَبْل الاِسْتِسْقَاءِ و هل يجب على الامام الامر بها؟
What is the ruling on the donor taking back his charity?
ما حكم الرُّجُوعُ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ
What are the characteristics of the person to be eligible to give voluntary sadaqa?
ما هي صفات المتصدق؟
Can a woman give voluntary sadaqah from her husband's wealth?
ما حكم صَدَقَةُ الْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ مَال زَوْجِهَا
Was the Prophet ﷺ allowed to take voluntary sadaqah?
ما حكم الصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
